sources.quote: 🔹 New pricing takes effect at 04:00 UTC on Sept 10, 2026.
sources.supports: DeepSeek states the exact effective time for the new pricing.

sources.quote: V4.1-Flash lets us serve more users at a lower cost. We're passing the savings on to you.
sources.supports: DeepSeek describes the announcement as a lower price, establishing a provider price change.

sources.quote: The legacy names `deepseek-v4-flash` and `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` are still accepted, but the corresponding models have been retired, their requests are served by the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model and billed at the Flash price.
sources.supports: Current provider documentation confirms legacy V4 Flash requests route to the new model at its price.

notes: DeepSeek's announcement explicitly calls this lower pricing and gives its effective time as 04:00 UTC on September 10, 2026, so this was a provider price change rather than a models.dev correction. The available extract of the provider pricing page contains no rate table, so the official earlier rate cannot be independently quoted from the supplied and extractable primary sources.
